title: Run focused regression tests in isolated scratch space

spec.identity: Developer or ephemeral CI test process
spec.boundary: Synthetic in-memory fixtures and uniquely allocated OS temporary directories; no authoritative source repair

authorization.principal: Developer invoking checks or configured CI workflow
authorization.scope: Test-owned temporary files and temporary Git fixtures, removed by test cleanup
authorization.enforcement: mkdtemp-owned paths and human review of tests; no external resource credentials
authorization.deniedBehavior: Fail test and report; never modify engineering artifacts to make a test pass
